title: cannot easily put options examples inside jsdoc
body:
While documenting a widget or the instantsearch() fn, I would like to be able to put examples of option usage. Like it's done in angularjs documentation.

Those would then be inlined in the all options switch along with the description.

The issue being that currently we remove all line break from the description so that it fits the jsdoc table.

comments.body: This would be solved by having dedicated pages per wigets rather than a single page documentation which is hard to read on the long run. I will do a documentation changes proposal soon
